description: This file defines an interface for protocol adapter tests in Java, including an inner class for asserting equality of headers with filtering options.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: An interface serving as a base for protocol adapter tests, providing default assertion methods.

classes.name: WithFilteredHeadersAssert
classes.description: An inner class extending AbstractObjectAssert to facilitate headers comparison with filtering options.

methods.name: assertWithExternalHeadersThat
methods.description: Creates an assertion object to compare external headers of WithDittoHeaders objects.

methods.description: Overrides the equality assertion to compare headers with optional self-filtering.
